{"CommandLine":"python3 -c "
import pty, os, time, re, select

master, slave = pty.openpty()
pid = os.fork()
if pid == 0:
    os.close(master)
    os.dup2(slave, 0)
    os.dup2(slave, 1)
    os.dup2(slave, 2)
    os.close(slave)
    os.execvp('gh', ['gh', 'auth', 'login', '-h', 'github.com', '-p', 'https', '-w'])

            output += chunk

                os.write(master, b'Y\n')
                answered = True
            m = re.search(r'one-time code:\s*([A-Z0-9]{4}-[A-Z0-9]{4})', output)
            if m:
                code_found = m.group(1)
                break
    print('Found code:', code_found)
